title: PF2e Automatic Kineticist Resolution
description: Confirmation-first automation of the PF2e Kineticist: impulses read from their text (saves, impulse attacks, healing, stances, areas, creations), the kinetic aura, overflow and gate junctions.

recommends.reason: Impulses that have the effect of a spell (Wall of Fire, Earthquake, Vapor Form…) are resolved by the spell module when it's active.
